root_cause.evidence: The patch description states: "the synchronous error path in tls_do_encryption() performs the same cleanup again, double-decrementing encrypt_pending and double-restoring the scatterlist." The fix adds an early return after tls_encrypt_async_wait() error to skip the synchronous cleanup, as confirmed by the diff.
